results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the requested small-clock enlargement, both clocks’ hand positions change, the large clock is also enlarged/reframed, and the continuous wall becomes a divided composition. White rims, pale blue faces and black numerals remain. Instruction: 1. Both clocks now fill separate panels. 2. The left clock should match the original large clock’s size. 3. The left clock is enlarged but remains visibly smaller than the right, which also grows. 4. The size-match request is only partially achieved. Quality, edited image alone: structure ✘ because the right clock has an extra thick hand pointing toward 2 alongside the hands toward 1 and 10; naturalness ✔ for wall shadows, artifact-free ✘ for the hand anomaly, and surface textures ✔.

Consistency: the requested sofa setting, poster layout, lighting and framing changes are excluded. The cushion retains its square pointed silhouette and black/white fabric appearance, but its regular nested-diamond pattern is visibly changed into broken, intersecting angular motifs across the center. Instruction: 1. The cushion appears on a dark gray sofa with upper-left white type. 2. The expected poster uses a close view of the diamond cushion, a cool industrial interior and the coherent bold sans-serif title about life’s order. 3. The setting, palette, placement and font style are present, but most title wording is garbled and the geometric pattern is disrupted. 4. Partial compliance. Quality, edited image alone: structure ✘ for unreadable lower title lines and malformed intersecting cushion motifs; naturalness ✔ for sofa perspective and lighting; artifact-free ✘ for duplicated/overlapping letter fragments; texture fidelity ✔ for visible woven upholstery. Multiple distracting errors reduce quality.
